selection.name: codex
selection.role: C01: TypeScript SDK for Codex workers needing structured events, repeated turns and persisted-session resumption.

basis.shows: Supported CLI wrapper exchanging JSONL events; runStreamed() exposes structured progress events, startThread()/resumeThread() provide session control, and threads persist locally. Documents npm installation and Node.js 18+.
Documents Linux installation, Linux x86_64 binaries and macOS arm64 binaries. WSL2 suitability is inferred from Linux support; execution under WSL2 was not verified.
Latest inspected default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01, within the frozen 90-day window.
Release published 2026-10-01; the SDK documentation inspected was pinned to this tag.
SDK declares Jest tests and a coverage command. This establishes a test suite, not a passing result.
Sampled completed main-branch blocking-ci run failed on 2026-10-01. Failure cause and SDK involvement were not inspected.
Sampled completed main-branch postmerge-ci run also failed. Selection rests on documented capability and integration, without claiming measured reliability superiority.

selection.name: Claude Agent SDK
selection.role: C07: Python SDK for Claude workers needing typed messages, bidirectional sessions, custom tools and hooks.

basis.shows: Documents Python 3.10+, bundled Claude CLI, typed messages, ClaudeSDKClient bidirectional sessions, in-process custom tools, permission handling and hooks. Documents Linux and macOS wheel builds.
Ubuntu test job passed on the inspected latest commit, supporting Linux suitability; WSL2 execution remains unverified.
macOS test job passed. Runner architecture was not verified, so this does not establish macOS arm64 execution.
macOS end-to-end job failed on the same inspected commit.
Docker end-to-end job failed. Mixed CI limits confidence; these results do not establish release-tag reliability.

not_selected.name: OpenHands SDK
not_selected.reason: Strong documented SDK with events, custom tools and remote workspaces, but its demonstrated worker uses an OpenHands agent engine; no concrete need for that engine or remote-worker stack was supplied. This is a scope deferral, not measured inferiority. Active commit 2026-10-01; v1.50.1 released 2026-09-30. [Pinned README](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/blob/0a9abc87641ad7ffe02e2dadf5e2cb3976b35217/README.md), [release](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/releases/tag/v1.50.1).

not_selected.name: LangGraph
not_selected.reason: Documents stateful orchestration and durable execution, but no application need for graph orchestration was supplied; direct native-session integration was not established in the inspected README. Active commit 2026-10-01; latest-release endpoint returned a CLI tag dated 2026-09-23, rather than a verified core-library pin. [Pinned README](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/blob/157a06dda988d85afeb8751ff27b35ab3f4f8bf4/README.md), [release](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/releases/tag/cli%3D%3D0.4.32.dev0).

not_selected.name: agentproto/ts
not_selected.reason: Directly documents Claude Code/Codex adapters, durable session control and custom tools, making it a close alternative; its README warns of breaking API changes and does not establish a stable session-control SDK or event subscription. Passing CI was not assessed. Active commit and release 2026-10-01. [Pinned README](https://github.com/agentproto/ts/blob/c2472bf496845004c32fd64ff857ee05045e6360/README.md), [release](https://github.com/agentproto/ts/releases/tag/release%2F2026-10-01.2).

not_selected.name: copilot-sdk
not_selected.reason: Meets the custom-tool requirement and is a genuine alternative, but introduces the Copilot runtime for the named Claude Code/Codex users; inspected CI included passing Python checks and failed aggregate/Node checks. BYOK prevents a subscription-only exclusion. Active commit 2026-10-01; v1.0.16 released 2026-09-30. [Pinned README](https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/blob/0584472932d8124dc139f6e4fc35ea76397ef868/README.md), [failed aggregate check](https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/actions/runs/36899360472/job/110501493547), [release](https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/releases/tag/v1.0.16).

excluded.name: Temporal
excluded.fact: The nominated repository is the Temporal server; its README directs worker authors to separate language SDKs. The packet supplies no durable multi-host workflow requirement justifying this server layer. It is active, not stale: commit 2026-10-01 and v1.32.0 released 2026-09-11. [Pinned README](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/blob/95f69832293f851fdebeb6d790854918f6cfd563/README.md), [release](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/releases/tag/v1.32.0).

layers.deciding_comparison: The two selections cover separate native-client roles; neither is a measured overall winner. First qualify the concrete application gap. On clean WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64 and macOS arm64 hosts, compare the selected SDKs with Copilot SDK and agentproto using the same event/tool/session contract: installation success, event ordering and completeness, permission denial, cancellation, process failure and session resumption, overhead and integration effort. Include OpenHands if a separate agent engine or container worker is acceptable; qualify graph checkpoints before reconsidering LangGraph and durable multi-host state before reconsidering Temporal. Control backend/model differences where supported and score runtime behavior separately from model quality.
evidence_gaps: The required ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_search pipeline could not be completed: context tools were rejected because approval is required and policy is never. Six upstream READMEs were fetched directly before that restriction was coordinated; this method deviation is disclosed rather than presented as compliant.
Research used 30 GitHub API calls, one web search and six successful direct page fetches. Only the authorized packet was read under the local repository.

All seven repositories were unarchived and had inspected default-branch commits on 2026-10-01, after the 2026-07-03 cutoff. Release activity was verified; human issue-response activity and backlog handling were not systematically assessed.
The packet contains no completed head-to-head comparison. No matched public benchmark or evaluation was established from the inspected sources, so no measured superiority is claimed.
Codex SDK Jest commands were verified, but an isolated passing SDK CI result was not. Its sampled main-branch CI failures were not diagnosed.

Claude CI covered all 13 returned checks and was mixed. Copilot's check-runs response covered only 30 of 146 checks. The inspected LangGraph run was still in progress; OpenHands, agentproto and Temporal passing CI results were not assessed.

No target-host installation was executed. Codex explicitly documents Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 binaries; OpenHands release assets also cover those architectures. Claude macOS arm64 execution and WSL2 execution for every candidate remain unverified.
The inspected SDK entry points do not require a GPU; RTX 4090 compatibility becomes relevant only if a separately qualified local model backend is chosen.
Claude capabilities were inspected at current main, not the release tag. Codex documentation was inspected at rust-v0.160.0, but the corresponding published npm SDK version was not verified.

Claude authentication/payment requirements were not established. Codex documents ChatGPT-plan or API-key authentication, and Copilot documents BYOK. These findings do not justify excluding a repository as requiring a particular paid service.
Correction recorded: LangGraph's README establishes durable execution conceptually; a specific checkpoint API or multi-host persistence backend was not verified.
